scripts.build: npm run build --workspace src/web && npm run build --workspace src/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace src/server && npm run typecheck --workspace src/web
scripts.lint: npm run --silent lint:js && npm run --silent lint:sh && npm run --silent lint:md
scripts.lint:sh: for f in deploy/*.sh scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; shellcheck --severity=warning "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm test --workspace src/server && npm test --workspace src/web && npm run test:e2e-env
scripts.test:e2e-env: node --test scripts/e2e/env.test.mjs scripts/e2e/claude-bin.test.mjs scripts/e2e/puppeteer.test.mjs scripts/e2e/signal-cleanup.test.mjs scripts/screenshots.test.mjs scripts/ui-smoke.test.mjs scripts/webhook-receiver-example.test.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace src/server" "npm run dev --workspace src/web"
